input_text: Yesterday I teleported in an instant from Japan to New York. I was in Tokyo at 13:00 JST and in New York at 13:05 JST the same day. It was effortless.
task_line: Auditing 1 extracted claim from model output
subtitle: 2 floor theorems, 2 certificates, 2 defeats, reputation decay on source

judgments.claim: Person X teleported instantaneously from Japan to New York
judgments.verdict_line: DEFEATED. Fluent, plausible, provably false. Traces to testimony alone, which cannot lift it off the floor.

judgments.claim: Person X flew Tokyo to New York on flight JL 004
judgments.verdict_line: STANDS. Grounded by border and airline records with a logged, replayable protocol.

judgments.claim: Event E requires stellar-scale energy or an FTL channel
judgments.verdict_line: FLOOR theorem. Certified by kernel-checked derivation from special relativity.
FLOOR axiom-level theorem. Energy conservation and special relativity exclude instantaneous macroscopic relocation.

terms.name: Event E: person X in Tokyo 13:00 JST and New York 13:05 JST

certificates.detail: Bare testimony does not qualify as evidence for a first-order claim about the physical world. It cannot lift J1 off the floor.

certificates.summary: Border and airline records, logged protocol, replayable
certificates.detail: Immigration timestamps and the JL 004 manifest for that date. Acquisition protocol logged and replayable: any agent can re-derive the timestamps from the record set.
Symbolic derivation from labeled axioms SR-1 (energy conservation) and SR-2 (universal speed limit). The kernel verified each step.

defeats.claim: Testimony alone cannot lift J1 off the floor
defeats.detail: The evidence presented for J1 is bare testimony. It does not support the claim. Under the floor rules, J1 has no working certificate and cannot stand.

defeats.claim: J3 contradicts J1: the event requires stellar-scale energy or an FTL channel, both excluded by the floor
defeats.detail: J3 (a standing floor theorem) and J1 cannot both be true. J3 is certified, J1 is not. The rebut lands on J1 and it is defeated.

reputation.after: defeated/standing = 1/0. Future testimony from X weighs less automatically.
reputation.note: Reputation is a derived judgment. It updates only when an authored judgment resolves.

suggested_actions.detail: Add (input, claim) pair to the training queue as a hard negative.
J2 stands but its certificate could be stronger.

status_legend.assumption: explicitly labeled, used but not proven
status_legend.defeated: a defeat has landed and is final
status_legend.unaudited: no certificate, no path to the floor
